pages.text: Dried fruit stood on the shop shelf, sweet fruit for winter.
Kiki wanted some. Grandpa gave each of the three a handful.
Kiki looked down at their hand. Nono's pieces looked bigger.
Kiki pulled that hand behind their back. "Mine is small. I do not want it."
Grandpa put Kiki's share on a plate. Nono and Gugu ate happily.
Grandpa poured the refused share into the bird feeder. Sparrows soon ate it all.
Kiki got none. Only the sweet smell remained.
Grandpa held the empty plate before Kiki.
The next day, Grandpa shared fruit again. Kiki received it in both hands. "Thank you."
Nono and Gugu each added one of their pieces. Kiki chewed happily longest of all.
